answer: A stake-anchored identity registry resists Sybil attacks by forcing every agent to lock a meaningful deposit behind one verified identity before it can earn or vote. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits, and misbehaviour burns the stake, so farming identities stops paying. Like an oasis that only serves travellers who have registered at its gate, the registry gives honest agents a stable anchor of trust, while a bridge between separate services can check the same locked stake instead of trusting a new username each time.
